ORCA-EUR.summary: A live governance proposal creates near-term ORCA-specific event risk: it would redirect fee economics, transfer treasury assets to Team-controlled accounts, dissolve the Council, and proceed through an on-chain vote process. ([forums.orca.so](https://forums.orca.so/t/tokenholder-proposal-resourcing-orca-for-its-next-phase/1281?utm_source=openai))
materialRisks: Pending governance proposal would allocate 80% of protocol fees to Team operations, versus 20% combined to xORCA rewards and discretionary buybacks. ([forums.orca.so](https://forums.orca.so/t/tokenholder-proposal-resourcing-orca-for-its-next-phase/1281?utm_source=openai))

Proposal would move approximately 14.2M ORCA from the community treasury and all SOL from the fee treasury to Team-controlled accounts, creating execution, custody, and supply-overhang uncertainty. ([forums.orca.so](https://forums.orca.so/t/tokenholder-proposal-resourcing-orca-for-its-next-phase/1281?utm_source=openai))

The proposal also contemplates dissolving the Council and is tied to a proposed acquisition of another Solana DeFi protocol; vote, implementation, and transaction outcomes remain unresolved. ([forums.orca.so](https://forums.orca.so/t/tokenholder-proposal-resourcing-orca-for-its-next-phase/1281?utm_source=openai))

facts.fact: The proposal was posted September 29, 2026, and the Council unanimously endorsed submitting it to tokenholders. ([forums.orca.so](https://forums.orca.so/t/tokenholder-proposal-resourcing-orca-for-its-next-phase/1281?utm_source=openai))

Its stated process includes at least four days of forum discussion, a five-day voting period, and a two-day cool-down before implementation if passed. ([forums.orca.so](https://forums.orca.so/t/tokenholder-proposal-resourcing-orca-for-its-next-phase/1281?utm_source=openai))

Kraken’s current status page shows no ORCA-specific trading, deposit, or withdrawal incident; listed contemporaneous incidents concern other assets/services. ([status.kraken.com](https://status.kraken.com/?utm_source=openai))
Kraken officially supports an ORCA/EUR market, matching the supplied asset and quote pair. ([kraken.com](https://www.kraken.com/convert/orca/eur?utm_source=openai))
